<thought>Based on the mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 100.0524. A formula that matches this exact monoisotopic mass is C5H8O2 (60 + 8·1.007825 + 2·15.994915 = 100.0524 Da). The observed M+1 intensity (~5.6 % of the base peak) aligns with the expected 13C contribution from five carbons (≈5.5 %). Therefore the molecular formula is C5H8O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C5H8O2</final_answer>
